title: RT-safety grep-gate script (forbidden processBlock calls, ScopedNoDenormals, no random_device on audio thread)
description:
Add a CI-runnable RT-safety static grep gate per Build Spec §14 item 1 and D2 PRNG constraint. Wave-1 independent task; scripts only.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.cpp processBlock region (ScopedNoDenormals, engine call path)
- Source/DSP/ShredDoubleEngine.cpp, MeterTap.cpp, RandomWalk.cpp (audio-thread process paths; seeded xoshiro — must never touch std::random_device on audio thread)
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §7 (processBlock contract), §4 PRNG/D2, §14 item 1
- scripts/build_all.sh from phase A (cmake is NOT on PATH — CLion-bundled via build_all.sh)
- Sibling gate: ~/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width/scripts/check_rt_safety.sh (brace-scoped processBlock extraction pattern)

Implement scripts/check_rt_safety.sh:
1. Bash script, set -euo pipefail, runnable from repo root: `bash scripts/check_rt_safety.sh`.
2. Fail (non-zero) if processBlock-related sources reference forbidden APIs in audio-thread code paths. At minimum scope-check Source/PluginProcessor.cpp processBlock body and audio push paths (MeterTap push, engine process hot path) for: `\bnew\b`, malloc/free/realloc, juce::String, and lock primitives (std::mutex, scoped_lock, lock_guard, unique_lock, CriticalSection, MessageManager::callAsync). Prefer brace-counted scoped extraction over naive whole-file greps to avoid prepareToPlay false positives; document the strategy in script comments.
3. Assert `ScopedNoDenormals` is present in Source/PluginProcessor.cpp processBlock path; fail if missing.
4. Assert no `std::random_device` on audio-thread paths (processBlock, engine process, RandomWalk process/step hot code). Whole-file ban of std::random_device under Source/DSP/ and PluginProcessor process path is acceptable and preferred for D2 — PRNG must be seeded xoshiro/splitmix only.
5. Print clear PASS/FAIL lines on stdout; exit 0 only on full pass.
6. Do not require cmake on PATH; pure source grep (rg or grep -E).
7. Shebang + executable bit if environment allows.

Do not edit CMakeLists, C++ sources, presets, or docs.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/check_rt_safety.sh exists and is a bash script with a shebang
scripts/check_rt_safety.sh fails when processBlock/audio-thread sources contain forbidden patterns among new, malloc, juce::String, or lock primitives (as implemented)
scripts/check_rt_safety.sh asserts ScopedNoDenormals is present in Source/PluginProcessor.cpp
scripts/check_rt_safety.sh asserts no std::random_device on audio-thread / DSP process paths (D2 PRNG constraint)
scripts/check_rt_safety.sh exits 0 only on pass and prints PASS/FAIL diagnostics
Script does not assume cmake is on PATH
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: hard-code machine-specific absolute paths unrelated to repo-relative lookup

allowed: brace-scoped processBlock and MeterTap/engine process extraction modeled on shred-width check_rt_safety.sh
whole-file ban of std::random_device under Source/DSP and PluginProcessor
optional allowlist comments for known false positives
forbidden: edit C++ to silence the gate
own pluginval script or CMakeLists wiring
full dynamic allocator-hook sanitizer harness in this task (static grep only)
